inputs.text: KTR is accusing the Congress government of letting illegal mining go unchecked, and says a company belonging to Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved. If those allegations are true, this is more than ordinary political sparring: it points to a failure of public authority and raises serious questions about whether politically connected interests are being treated differently from everyone else. Illegal mining must be investigated and the law enforced—without regard to party or position.
